definitions.explanation: strong opposition or resistance to something
the force that pushes objects apart; bouncing back

examples.japanese: その{政策|せいさく}は{市民|しみん}の{反発|はんぱつ}を{招|まね}いた。
{親|おや}に{反発|はんぱつ}して{家|いえ}を{出|で}た。
examples.english: I left home in rebellion against my parents.

examples.japanese: ボールの{反発|はんぱつ}{力|りょく}が{強|つよ}い。
{同|おな}じ{極|きょく}の{磁石|じしゃく}は{反発|はんぱつ}する。
examples.english: Magnets with the same poles repel each other.

examples.japanese: {値上|ねあ}げに{強|つよ}い{反発|はんぱつ}があった。
examples.english: There was strong opposition to the price increase.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}{反発|はんぱつ}マットレスが{人気|にんき}だ。

notes:
VERB FORM:
{反発|はんぱつ}する - to oppose, to resist; to repel, to rebound

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反発|はんぱつ}を{招|まね}く - to invite opposition
- {反発|はんぱつ}{力|りょく} - repulsive force; resilience
- {高|たか}{反発|はんぱつ} - high resilience (mattresses, golf clubs)
- {低|てい}{反発|はんぱつ} - low resilience (memory foam)

CONTRAST:
{反感|はんかん} is a feeling of dislike, while {反発|はんぱつ} involves active opposition or resistance.
